intro: Wynwood Grand is an executive condominium at Woodlands Drive 17, in District 25. City Developments Limited’s SGX operational update for the first quarter of 2026, as recorded in our project file, lists a 430-unit EC at this address and an expected launch in the first quarter of 2027. The name Wynwood Grand is recorded from subsequent reporting of a CDL briefing. Tenure is listed as 99 years. That launch window is a developer expectation and may change. TOP is not officially confirmed, and we have not used unofficial e-application dates from agent sites. Individual typologies are not in our file. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Wynwood Grand renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Wynwood Grand interior
sections.text:
Woodlands is a mature northern town, and an EC here is usually bought as a long-stay family home. The first fit-out is therefore worth doing properly: an entry cabinet that can take shoes and school bags, a living-room joinery wall, full-height wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry rather than loose cabinets. A common bedroom often becomes a study or a child’s room; a built-in desk and wardrobe along one wall keeps the floor clear. Maison is an interior designer. We specify built-in carpentry, not IKEA-style furniture, and we can work in wide room views or in closer studies of a kitchen run, a wardrobe or a headboard wall.

No official floor plan is on file, so this page does not list typologies or room sizes, and we will not invent a typical Wynwood Grand layout. Norwood Grand, already live on this site, is another CDL condominium in Woodlands and is the natural nearby page for readers in the same town. The two projects are not interchangeable: typologies, tenure start dates and management rules must be taken from each estate’s own documents. We will not invent walking times to Woodlands town or to any MRT station. Check your eventual stack and facing before you plan blinds or a window bench.

If you are considering a Q1 2027 launch, it is still early for on-site work and not too early for a design conversation once a plan is available. After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain renovation approval before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. We are not affiliated with CDL.

faq.q: When is the Wynwood Grand launch?
faq.a: Our project file records: 2027-Q1 planned launch. That is a developer expectation and may change. It is not a TOP or a key date.

faq.q: Is the TOP date for Wynwood Grand confirmed?
faq.a: No. TOP is not officially confirmed in our file. We have left any unofficial booking or e-application dates out.

faq.q: Do you have the Wynwood Grand floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved unit plan.

faq.q: Can I renovate right after keys?
faq.a: After handover, inspect defects and obtain the management corporation’s renovation approval first. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals; that is an editorial allowance, not a guarantee.
